title: SENARA Creative Artfest 2026
sub: The website for SENARA Creative Artfest, the student art exhibition run by PPI Malaysia. For 2026 the event is a collaboration with Instellar, so I re-themed the existing static site around the new artwork and added a full Online Exhibition section with category pages and artwork detail pages.

meta.Role: Head of Website Division, PPI Malaysia

title: AI Eval Dashboard
sub: An automated test harness for AI model output. Instead of reading answers by hand, Claude grades each one as correct, partial, incorrect or hallucinated, and the dashboard reports accuracy, latency and cost per request.

title: PriceWatch
sub: A Chrome extension that watches a product price on any site and tells you when it drops. You point at the price on the page once; it re-checks every three hours in the background.

title: PaperMind
sub: A local RAG-powered academic paper analyzer. Upload any PDF, ask questions, get structured summaries, running 100% privately on self-hosted hardware. Zero cloud, zero cost, zero data leakage.

title: AI Digit Recognizer
sub: A handwritten digit classifier with a convolutional network written from scratch in NumPy, no PyTorch and no TensorFlow. Draw a digit and watch the signal move through every layer.

title: Snip URL Shortener
sub: A serverless URL shortener with click analytics. Three AWS Lambda functions behind API Gateway, a single DynamoDB table, all described as infrastructure-as-code with AWS SAM. Built to turn an AWS Developer Associate (DVA-C02) certificate into something real, deployable, and honest about where it actually runs today.

title: Nalar
sub: A full-stack personal blog with a CMS I built from scratch, no WordPress, no Ghost, no static-site generator. Write in Markdown with live preview, save drafts, schedule posts to publish themselves, and browse by tag. Reading is public; writing sits behind real authentication. It runs on a mini PC under my desk and reaches the internet through a Cloudflare Tunnel at blog.rafiarsya.com.

title: Crop Disease Detector
sub: An AI model that identifies plant diseases from a single leaf photo. MobileNetV2 + Transfer Learning trained on 87,000+ images across 38 disease classes. ~97% accuracy. Live on Hugging Face Spaces, free to use.

title: IDFEST 2026 Website
sub: The official website for IDFEST 2026, an Indonesian cultural festival organized by PPI Universiti Malaya. A collaborative build translating Figma designs into a fast, static Next.js frontend across the home timeline, Art Exhibition, and Musical Theater sections.

title: Steam Market Intelligence
sub: A live, in-browser SQL analytics dashboard, real SQLite compiled to WebAssembly, querying a 1,400-title game-market dataset on every page load. No backend, no precomputed export, just a database and a query engine running on the visitor's machine.

title: Arena Duel
sub: A server-authoritative real-time multiplayer duel. Two players connect from different devices, lock in a secret action every round, and the server resolves the outcome fairly and deterministically. No database, no accounts, no AI, just the hard parts: state machines, race conditions, and cheat-proof multiplayer architecture.

title: Resume Match
sub: An algorithmic resume-to-job scoring engine, upload a resume PDF and a job description, get a fit score with a full breakdown of matched skills, missing skills, and extra value. No AI model, no API key, no database, pure tokenization, synonym canonicalization, and weighted scoring.

title: NASE Accessibility
sub: A full accessibility audit and redesign of the NASE platform for visually impaired users. 23 issues found, categorised by WCAG 2.1 severity, with redesigned components and an AI-powered contrast analysis pipeline.

title: HandGesture
sub: Draw on screen with just your index finger, real-time hand landmark detection, gesture classification, and canvas rendering from a live webcam feed. No hardware required.

title: Reminder Me
sub: A personal “companion agent” for daily life as a student, habits, focus sessions, tasks, exams, prayer times, health, and journalling, all in one offline-first app. Built as an installable PWA and wrapped as a real Android APK via a Trusted Web Activity. No backend, no account, no cloud, everything lives on the device.

title: BriskWalk
sub: Event registration platform for PPI Malaysia's annual community charity walk. Designed in Figma, built with vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, multi-step form, client-side image compression, and a Google Sheets backend.

title: RafiFinance
sub: A complete personal finance tracker built as a single HTML file. No server, no database, no framework. Transactions, budgets, saving goals, health score, 6-month analysis, works offline as a PWA.

title: Large Number Arithmetic
sub: A course project for WIA1002 Data Structures: arithmetic on numbers far larger than any built-in type, using a doubly linked list where every digit is its own node, with a visualizer that walks the algorithm step by step.

title: CSA Study App
sub: A self-contained exam prep tool for WRES1201 (Computer Systems Architecture). Topic guide, formula reference, MCQ drills, and interactive visualizers for cache mapping, Hamming codes, and arithmetic shifts, with every number re-randomized on each reload so it never gets stale.

title: LLM Response Preference Baseline
sub: Given a prompt and two chatbot answers, predict which one a human preferred, or whether they called it a tie. An end-to-end TF-IDF and logistic regression pipeline, built and verified on a small synthetic stand-in before the real Chatbot Arena dataset.
